This cancer journey came to a surprise. Jaqueline Ramirez Juarez is a senior and honors student at Cedartown High School in Georgia. She’s a part of the National Honors Society, Key Club, and Skills USA. She was recently accepted to Georgia Highlands College and had plans of studying to become a nurse. She comes from a single-parent household and takes care of her younger siblings. Now, after being detained by ICE just a few weeks before graduation, her family has been left with financially hardship from all of the legal fees. #jaquel
